FFmpeg 9.0.2, LGPL-2.1-or-later profile; only ALAC decoder + avutil enabled.
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
SHA256: 8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e
cmake/build_alac.py uses a private out-of-tree build and never patches sources.
Source release attachments include the actual source tree used for that build.
The plugin can be rebuilt/relinked using the included source and build scripts.
No FFmpeg executable or shared DLL is needed at runtime.
